chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"There is no harm in delaying the visitation of the House until the Day of Departure."

key_terms.زِيَارَةُ: the visitation rite, referring here to visiting the Sacred House during hajj
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يَوْمِ النَّفْرِ: the Day of Departure from Minā during hajj

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay the visitation of the Kaaba until Yawm al-Nafr?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is permissible to delay the visitation of the House, meaning the hajj ziyārah rite, until Yawm al-Nafr. It conveys a legal ruling of ease within the rites of hajj and indicates flexibility in the timing of this act.
